action: Place the probe on the abdomen. Attempt to locate the pancreas on the screen.
interpretation: Identify the initial position of the pancreas.

action: Scan specifically for anatomical landmarks.
interpretation: Look for the splenic vein and portal confluence to orient the view.

action: Assess the position of the organ on the display.
interpretation: Observe that the pancreas is located at the very anterior portion of the screen.

action: Adjust depth and focus prior to detailed scanning.
interpretation: Ensure settings match the specific anatomy being visualized.

action: Plan the transverse interrogation to scan in sections. Isolate the pancreatic head first.
interpretation: Break up the interrogation to examine the head independently.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take a big breath in and hold that breath in'.
interpretation: Use inspiration to displace bowel gas and optimize the window.

action: Focus attention exclusively on the pancreatic head.
interpretation: Isolate the pancreatic head for the first sweep.

action: Sweep the probe all the way through the tissue and then sweep all the way back up.
interpretation: Complete a full sweep through the pancreatic head tissue.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe'.
interpretation: Allow patient to relax between sweeps.

action: Shift focus to the body and tail of the pancreas for the next interrogation.
interpretation: Prepare to scan the remaining portions of the gland.

action: Instruct patient: 'Big breath in and hold that breath'.
interpretation: Re-establish the acoustic window.

action: Start superiorly and sweep inferiorly. Adjust depth dynamically while sweeping through the tail, then sweep back up.
interpretation: Visualize the tail of the pancreas, modifying depth to accommodate anatomical changes during the sweep.

action: Prepare for longitudinal interrogation before capturing images.
interpretation: Switch planes to ensure complete assessment.

action: Rotate transducer to the longitudinal plane. Locate the pancreatic head.
interpretation: Identify the pancreatic head anterior to the IVC.

action: Instruct patient: 'Big breath'. Correct instruction: 'Sorry, breathe normally'.
interpretation: Adjust patient breathing instructions based on image optimization needs.

action: Begin the longitudinal sweep.
interpretation: Initiate scan in the longitudinal plane.

action: Move focus and depth continuously to match the anatomy while sweeping.
interpretation: Maintain optimal resolution throughout the longitudinal sweep.

action: Sweep out and return to the starting position.
interpretation: Complete the longitudinal interrogation loop.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe'.
interpretation: End breath hold.

action: Prepare to capture an overall image of the gland in the transverse plane.
interpretation: Set up for the general survey image.

action: Instruct patient: 'Nice big breath when you're ready. Hold that breath in'.
interpretation: Optimize view for image capture.

action: Freeze image.
interpretation: Visualize the pancreatic body and tail.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally'. Annotate image: 'Trans Pancreas'.
interpretation: Label the overall gland shot.

action: Prepare to capture an image specifically of the pancreatic head.
interpretation: Isolate the head for documentation.

action: Instruct patient: 'Big breath and hold it'.
interpretation: Optimize window for the pancreatic head.

action: Adjust depth to match the specific structure being imaged. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally'.
interpretation: Ensure depth is optimized for the head.

action: Annotate image: 'Trans Pancreas' and add 'H' for Head.
interpretation: Specific annotation for the pancreatic head image.

action: Prepare to capture body and tail. Instruct patient: 'Big breath'.
interpretation: Target the body and tail for the next image.

action: Angle the transducer to visualize the tail along with the body. Instruct patient: 'Breathe'. Capture the image.
interpretation: Visualize the pancreatic tail and body.

action: Rotate to longitudinal. Freeze image at the level of the head. Annotate: 'Long' or 'Sag Panc Head'.
interpretation: Document the pancreatic head in the longitudinal plane.

action: Move probe to target the body of the pancreas.
interpretation: Note that the body is quite thin compared to the head and tail.

action: Instruct patient: 'Big breath in for me... and hold that breath'.
interpretation: Prepare for longitudinal body image capture.

action: Freeze image.
interpretation: Capture the longitudinal view of the pancreatic body.

action: Move probe to target the tail of the pancreas.
interpretation: Transition to the final segment.

action: Adjust depth and focus. Instruct patient: 'Breathe'. Ensure focus is placed at the posterior aspect of the target.
interpretation: Optimize the final image, ensuring the focus marker aligns with the posterior anatomy.
